This appears to be a CBP ruling on a Halloween decoration kit with skeleton spiders and a black light. Festive articles fall under heading 9505. A set of plastic spiders plus an LED black light would be classified as a set or kit, and the essential character comes from the spiders, which are festive articles. The classification is therefore 9505.90.6000 (other festive, carnival or other entertainment articles: other).

The alternative, 9505.10 (Christmas articles), does not apply because the kit is Halloween-themed. The remaining 9505.90 subheadings are 9505.90.20 (face masks and similar), 9505.90.40 (the Halloween-type items are not separately listed), and 9505.90.60 (other), so 9505.90.6000 is the correct one.
